title: Initial code quality (BASE), block full_ext
population: BASE (iteration-0 artifacts of the base cells)
notes: Cells: percentage (numerator/denominator) of base cells; Q04 over assembled artifacts.

Denominator exclusions (methodology missingness rules; JSON key excluded): no unit is excluded in this table by Q06 (baseline_incompatible artifact(s)); Q04 (unassembled artifact(s) (Q04 counts over assembled artifacts)).
REASONING: Reasoning settings differ between models and are not equalised (see the closure disclosure register, item reasoning_policy_differences); some providers report no reasoning-token field.

IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test_feedback and combined_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped_tests_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.

IC7: The pipeline auto-closes unbalanced braces before measurement; many static_feedback regressions are base-pass cells whose final repair answer was auto-closed and then failed to build (X01). Q10 (frozen SA2) is unpaired and compares different cohorts.

definitions.text: BASE: the 1,980 base cells (pilot_002 396 + full_ext_001 1,584), iteration-0 artifacts (use: initial code quality)
Q02 assembly_success: numerator = assembled == true; denominator = artifacts; unit = artifact.
Q05 build_success: numerator = correctness compile.ok == true; denominator = artifacts with a correctness record; unit = artifact.
Q06 correctness_pass: numerator = verdict == pass; denominator = artifacts with a correctness verdict other than baseline_incompatible; unit = artifact.
Q04 cleaning_intervention: numerator = artifacts with the flag; denominator = assembled artifacts; unit = artifact.

ci_note: 95% CI: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, percentile intervals, stratified by block (pilot benchmarks resampled among the 12 pilot benchmarks, full_ext among its 48); seed 20261017; cluster = benchmark; 2,000 replicates (descriptive, unadjusted)
